findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle or other unsafe methods can lead to arbitrary code execution.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/aiohttp-unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Use of unsafe deserialization functions (pickle/yaml/marshal load) that could lead to code execution (CWE-502)

message.text: Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Pickle loads context in cookiejar
 * @description Identify the function containing pickle loads in cookiejar to assess reachability
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/aiohttp-pickle-context
 * @tags security
 */

import python

from Call call, Function f
where
  call.getFunc().(Attribute).getObject().(Name).getId() = "pickle" and
  call.getFunc().(Attribute).getName() in ["load", "loads"] and
  f = call.getScope()
select call, "pickle." + call.getFunc().(Attribute).getName() + " in function " + f.getQualifiedName()
findings.hypothesis: Identify the function containing pickle.loads to assess reachability and exploitability

message.text: pickle.load in function CookieJar.load

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Static file serving functions with filesystem access
 * @description Functions in web_urldispatcher.py that perform file system access
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity note
 * @id py/aiohttp-static-fs-functions
 * @tags security
 */

import python
import semmle.python.Concepts

from Function f, FileSystemAccess fa
where
  f.getLocation().getFile().getAbsolutePath().matches("%/aiohttp/web_urldispatcher.py")
  and fa.getAPathArgument().getScope() = f
select f, "Function with filesystem access: " + f.getName()
findings.hypothesis: Identify functions handling static file serving to inspect path traversal safeguards

message.text: Function with filesystem access: __init__
Function with filesystem access: url_for

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name String concat in static file path construction
 * @description Locate binary + expressions near static file serving code
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity note
 * @id py/aiohttp-static-path-concat
 * @tags security
 */

import python

from BinaryExpr be
where
  be.getLocation().getFile().getAbsolutePath().matches("%/aiohttp/web_urldispatcher.py")
  and be.getLocation().getStartLine() > 540
  and be.getLocation().getStartLine() < 640
  and be.getOp() instanceof Add
select be, "String concatenation in static file path: " + be.toString()
findings.hypothesis: Inspect path construction logic in static file serving for path traversal

message.text: String concatenation in static file path: BinaryExpr
